E0106

Redefining a built-in

What

Redefining a built-in

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0106

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0106: tests/ui/incomparable_eq.stderr.

Error [E0106]: the name `Tally` is built in and can't be redefined
  --> tests/ui/incomparable_eq.jet:1:8
    |
  1 | struct Tally {
    |        ^^^^^
 Why: `Tally` is provided by the language itself
 Fix: choose a different name for this struct
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0106

Error [E0119]: there's no type called `Tally`
  --> tests/ui/incomparable_eq.jet:5:12
    |
  5 | fn same(a: Tally, b: Tally) Bool -> (a == b)
    |            ^^^^^
 Why: the types are `Int`, `Float`, `Bool`, and `String` (plus types you define)
 Fix: check the spelling, or define the struct or enum first

Error [E0312]: `Tally` doesn't support `==`
  --> tests/ui/incomparable_eq.jet:5:38
    |
  5 | fn same(a: Tally, b: Tally) Bool -> (a == b)
    |                                      ^^^^^^
 Why: value equality requires the Equatable trait
 Fix: add `#Equatable` before the type, implement `Equatable` by hand, or compare individual fields
